newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish printer Poligrafia plans October IPO.
newsitem.headline: Polish printer Poligrafia plans October IPO.

text.p: Polish printing house Poligrafia SA will conduct a public offering later this month and seeks to enter the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse, the firm's president said on Thursday.
"We plan to enter the bourse's parallel floor," Helena Zych told a news conference after the Polish Securities Commission approved 5,606,800 Poligrafia shares for public trade.
She declined to give the price.
Polish construction firm Exbud SA holds 88.76 percent of Poligrafia shareholder votes and a subsidiary of The Fleming Poland Fund Ltd holds 9.99 percent.
The shares will be offered ex-rights with the large-investor, 857,280-share tranche due from October 28 to October 31 and the 500,000-share retail tranche due from October 21 to October 25.
Large investors can register for 1,005 to 857,280 shares. Zych said the majority of the proceeds would go toward purchasing new printing machinery.
Poligrafia had a net profit of 800,000 zlotys last year on 24.5 million zlotys in sales.
